sources.author: Google Street View
observations: Live pixels inspected2026-10-22. Twelve windows each upper row, hood mouldings at every third first-floor window, segmental top heads. Nine bays over Halifax, three over number6. Continuous dentilled eaves, white surrounds, fine plain brick vents.

Halifax ground has grey granite piers, central recessed double entrance, two ATMs to its right, full blue fascia with raised white word and striped crossed bands, projecting side signs. Number6 has dark shopfront surround, Post & Packing fascia and separate dark access door. No current occupancy is asserted.

roof_repair_review.evidence: Re-inspected retained halifax-roof-reference.png and prezzo-rear-streetview-pan.png. Live browser profile remained locked; no new Google Maps 3D inspection claimed.
findings: The previous rear n-gon was non-planar and its triangulation created a false fold. The replacement uses three explicit planes with a hipped Glebe end and cutouts for the rear court and north neighbour.
The rectangular north party wall and uncut roof crossed both existing Prezzo escape stairs. Northern setbacks and masonry now leave both stair volumes unobstructed.
Rear court eaves and wall returns follow the rear pitch rather than forcing every eave vertex to the same height.
roof_repair_review.uncertainty: North setback coordinates follow visually inferred separation and existing Prezzo model geometry, not a measured cadastral boundary. Exact ridge height, pitch and hidden returns remain estimates pending a fresh 3D review.

findings: Glebe windows have a narrow top transom and large plain lower pane, not the street sash module. Brick-filled upper openings align with the two real casements.

The recessed court wall carries four varied upper windows, three lower small barred windows and a larger low barred opening. Earlier boundary trimming discarded two windows, while the lower trio had been placed incorrectly on the projecting southern wall.

Rear eave lowered relative to street elevation to better match the two-storey courtyard composition. Chimney/rooflight repositioned relative to the corrected windows; north roof cutouts and stair clearances retained.
rear_side_correction.limits: Fresh browser attempts with normal offscreen, GPU-disabled offscreen and headless Chrome stalled on Google Maps screenshots.
